title: Eratosthenes sieve dynamics beyond 2p: code, data and verification
description: Code, data and verification scripts accompanying the preprint by T. Hojka, "Exact dynamics of Eratosthenes sieve beyond 2p: coincident fusions, births of gaps and missing differences" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23007183). Code is licensed under MIT; data and documents under CC BY 4.0.
